title: Battle of Chemillé (April 11, 1793)
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Chemillé (April 11, 1793)", at revision 1370108973, opens: "The Battle of Chemillé, also referred to as the Clash of Chemillé, occurred on April 11, 1793, during the War in the Vendée (1793–1796). The Vendéens emerged triumphant, repelling the Republicans' assault on the town of Chemillé." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q2888302, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "1793 battle". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
